name: Nuitépine
source:
A dark and twisted forest- and also the very embodiment of death itself. 

For centuries it has grown, cursing the land and releasing beasts that devour the people. It is only a matter of time before this malevolent forest engulfs the world...

Prince Perrin of Lysaria is loved by the people yet despised by their family, save for their sickly mother. In order to keep the peace, Perrin has constantly bent to their father's whims while tolerating the despicable behavior of their two elder brothers. However,  with the impending transfer of the crown,  Perrin realizes they have little time left to secure the freedom and happiness of themselves, their mother, and the Kingdom of Lysaria.

Join Perrin as their fate slowly intertwines with Nuitépine in their desperate attempt to protect all that they hold dear.

[From [url=https://sudachys.itch.io/nuitepine]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一片幽暗、扭曲的森林，也是死亡本身的化身。

幾百年來，它不斷蔓延，詛咒著大地，放出吞食人類的惡獸。這片邪惡的森林遲早會把整個世界吞沒……

利薩里亞的佩蘭王子深受百姓愛戴，可在家中，除了體弱多病的母親，人人都瞧不起佩蘭。為了息事寧人，佩蘭總是順著父親的心意，也一直忍受著兩個兄長的卑劣行徑。如今王位交接在即，要為自己、母親和整個王國爭得自由與幸福，時間已經不多了。

為了守住珍愛的一切，佩蘭將拼盡全力。而在這一路上，王子的命運也漸漸與夜棘森林纏繞在一起。

（來源：[url=https://sudachys.itch.io/nuitepine]itch.io[/url]）
